findings.title: traceID no longer included in plugin request log lines
findings.body: The old logRequest appended `traceID` from `tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` to every "Plugin Request Completed" line. That was removed on the assumption that the contextual logger supplies it. The new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname, not traceID. Unless infra log's FromContext adds the trace ID on its own, the data-egress logs lose trace correlation.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to the exported Logger interface breaks other implementations
findings.body: Adding a method to the exported `plog.Logger` interface breaks every other implementation of it, including mocks and enterprise or external wrappers, at compile time. Only TestLogger and grafanaInfraLogWrapper are updated in this PR. Separately, `TestLogger.FromContext` returns a fresh TestLogger, so any logs written through the returned logger cannot be asserted on the original test logger. Tests of LoggerMiddleware will silently see zero calls.
